card.fires_on: The 'cardi' or 'i' piece in the middle of 'cardiotoxicity' or 'cardiomyopathy', mostly in anthracycline (doxorubicin, mitoxantrone, daunorubicin) warnings.

modes.label: Split after Card
modes.description: The 'i' piece when the word starts a sentence or list item as Card-i-otoxicity or Card-i-omyopathy.

modes.label: Split after cardi
modes.description: The ' cardi' piece after words like delayed, induced or risk of, before -otoxicity or -omyopathy.
